provenance: Expert-curated calibration set authored by the A11yForge team, grounded in WCAG 2.1 alt-text techniques (H37, F30, G94, H67, F39) and the W3C WAI 'alt decision tree'. This is a small EXPERT-labeled reference set for judge calibration, NOT crowd-sourced and NOT a statistical sample of the web. Each item's expertLabel is the intended ground-truth category. 'context' describes what the image actually depicts and where it is used, since the LLM judge sees only text, not pixels.
kappaTarget: Cohen's kappa (judge category vs expertLabel), gated: >=0.6 hard, 0.4-0.6 advisory, <0.4 backstops-only
